chapters.label: Open the server’s Services tab — every systemd service
Click “+ Add service”, give it a name and description
The start command, its folder and the user it runs as
Environment variables — or pick a saved environment
Restart “always”, start on boot, start it now
Create the service — it is written, enabled and started
Find it in the list — running, and marked “created here”
Click its name to read the journal
Actions: restart, stop, turn “start on boot” off, or delete
